subject.title: iOS: keychain save fails on fresh install (cal save failed / disconnected because it could not securely save)

question: Should the first remediation instrument and reproduce the exact Keychain OSStatus in a production-signed build before changing storage attributes or entitlements?
rationale: The current Boolean abstraction cannot distinguish a release-signing defect from a Keychain query defect, and an unverified fallback could weaken protection for gateway credentials.

options.title: Instrument and reproduce first
options.body: Return a typed redacted OSStatus, capture signed-device evidence, and change storage or entitlements only after the failing condition is identified.

options.title: Audit release entitlements first
options.body: Compare v2026.7.1 production signing and Keychain entitlements with the older working build, then ship a signing correction if the device status confirms it.

options.title: Change Keychain attributes immediately
options.body: Adjust accessibility or query attributes without the missing OSStatus, accepting higher regression and security-boundary risk.

recommendation.title: Instrument and reproduce first
recommendation.body: Return a typed redacted OSStatus, capture signed-device evidence, and change storage or entitlements only after the failing condition is identified.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent iOS connection ownership and direct involvement in the issue make this person the best available route for signed-device diagnosis.
